security_questionnaire_summary: High-level answers submitted for SIG/CAIQ. Key points: (1) Data residency: can restrict storage/compute to US or EU regions; no PHI to third countries without DPA amendment. (2) Auth: supports SSO/SAML + SCIM for provisioning. (3) Audit logging: platform can emit detailed request/response metadata to customer-managed CloudWatch/Stackdriver; retention configurable up to 7 years via Redwood Console add-on. (4) KMS: supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and external HSM; key wrapping options available; bring-your-own-key (BYOK) flow documented. (5) Network: Private VPC peering, Transit Gateway and on-prem VPN options provided. (6) Shared responsibility: Redwood handles runtime and infra hardening, patching, kernel-level isolation; customer responsible for prompt/content hygiene, key custody and access policies, and internal access controls.

- Quote: provisional, pending legal + security checklist completion.
